definition: Pre-2020 counts use local catalog article.year groupings or Scopus annual source-details document counts where available; issues are null when no historical issue count is supported. 2020-2026 papers/issues exactly match reviewed dashboard outputs. Local catalog counts may include Online First or non-eligible records. Citation counts are local verified distinct citing documents and catalog-confirmed citation-edge occurrences; Scopus total citations are not substituted for confirmed edges. Years above 2026 excluded.

journals.institutionalOwnership: Viện Toán học (Institute of Mathematics, VAST) & Springer Nature; NOT NXB Khoa học tự nhiên và Công nghệ.
